decisions.reason: As the current analytics standard and a close fit with the firm's plugin, analytics, and shop-support capabilities, this offering is likely to be retained because the initial development can still be justified and there is no clear sign of irreversible failure.

A Google Universal Analytics plugin is strategically obsolete by 2024, and because it was only mentioned rather than strongly showcased, management has relatively little public commitment to defend and is likely to withdraw it.

A retail system interface plugin matches the firm's technical integration strengths and likely required meaningful development effort, which under escalation of commitment makes management inclined to continue rather than write off the investment quickly.

This SEO relaunch support service was presented on its own page, signalling visible public commitment and alignment with the firm's core full-service e-commerce positioning, so management is likely to keep it on the market.
